implementation_summary: PDF requests on export, pitch and owner now take one of 2 slots per route factory instance (deps.maxConcurrentPdf to override). When the slots are full the route answers 503 at once with Retry-After: 5, a fixed sentence and ERR_RUN_IN_PROGRESS. The slot is released in a finally block. Non-PDF formats are not limited. Three tests were added: third PDF gets 503, non-PDF still works while two PDFs render, slot released after a render error.
risks: ERR_RUN_IN_PROGRESS is reused with 503 although its type comment says 409; the wizard must treat 503 + Retry-After as try again later.
The slot is held from the start of the request, including store load and pitch screenshot reads, not only the Chromium print; this is slightly conservative.
The Retry-After value is a fixed 5 seconds, not derived from render time.
handoff: Nothing to wire: the runner's call to auditExportRoutes needs no change (the default is 2). Optionally add a wizard message for a 503 on PDF downloads. docs/API.md could mention the 503 and Retry-After (not in my ownership).
